# Hausio

> Hausio is a London home-services company offering cleaning, man and van / removals, handyman, furniture assembly, TV mounting, garden clearance, waste removal and painting & decorating across all 32 London boroughs. Vetted, DBS-checked, £2M insured, eco-friendly, with £0 to pay until the job is done.

## Key facts

- Service area: all 32 London boroughs (Greater London).
- Prices: cleaning from £22/hr, man and van from £55/hr, handyman £65 first hour then £50/hr, furniture assembly from £45/hr, TV mounting from £55, garden clearance from £120, waste removal from £55, painting £220/painter/day.
- Booking: instant online quote at https://hausio.co.uk/book.html — pay £0 at booking, settle by card/Apple Pay/Google Pay after the job.
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 08:00–20:00.
- Trust: DBS-checked and reference-vetted staff, £2M public liability + £25k goods-in-transit cover.

## Services

- [Cleaning in London](https://hausio.co.uk/cleaning-london.html): regular, one-off, deep, end-of-tenancy and after-builders cleaning from £22/hr.
- [Man and van in London](https://hausio.co.uk/man-and-van-london.html): single items to full flat/house moves from £55/hr, same-day available.
- [Handyman in London](https://hausio.co.uk/handyman-london.html): repairs, assembly, mounting, minor plumbing and electrics — £65 first hour.
- [Furniture assembly in London](https://hausio.co.uk/furniture-assembly-london.html): IKEA, Made.com, Wayfair — from £45/hr or fixed price by item.
- [TV wall mounting in London](https://hausio.co.uk/tv-mounting-london.html): plasterboard, brick, concrete, cable-conceal — from £55.
- [Garden clearance in London](https://hausio.co.uk/garden-clearance-london.html): overgrowth, sheds, decking — from £120, registered waste carrier.
- [Waste removal in London](https://hausio.co.uk/waste-removal-london.html): single items to full house clearance — from £55, transfer notes included.
- [Painting & decorating in London](https://hausio.co.uk/painting-decorating-london.html): single rooms to whole flats — £220/painter/day, prep included.
